runtimeDivergences.reason: Canonical Dev must have a distinct installed launcher/visible identity and route normal runtime to WITCH_DEV_MAIN rather than silently executing Stable while appearing to be Dev. Tampermonkey identity must remain stable across versions so updates replace the existing Dev install instead of creating duplicates. Issue-scoped task branches may temporarily self-route for isolated validation, but must normalize before canonical integration.
acceptance: Canonical Tampermonkey @name is the fixed WITCH DOCK - DEV identity and @namespace remains stable.
Canonical userscript @version, runtime DEV_VERSION, manifest launcher version/build, and visible Dock title version remain synchronized.
Visible Dock title is formatted WITCH DOCK - DEV v<version>; the changing version is not embedded in Tampermonkey @name.
Canonical update/download URLs, manifest URL, and manifest-loaded runtime URLs resolve to WITCH_DEV_MAIN.
A Dev bootstrap/channel-seam failure is visible rather than silently falling back to Stable.

runtimeDivergences.reason: Architecture work on wd/10-modular-bootstrap is incrementally moving runtime ownership out of the Stable-derived monolith. v1.3.6 moves core Dock CSS ownership into features/core/Witch_Dock_Styles.css, fetched in parallel with the legacy core and inserted only through the bounded privileged-host style capability. The temporary source-transform seam replaces the legacy addStyles implementation with a no-op after proving the external stylesheet matches the guarded legacy CSS contract plus the already-approved 48px compact-icon adjustment.
acceptance: Task launcher and manifest identify v1.3.6 / build 1.3.6-extracted-core-css consistently.
The new witch-dock-styles registry entry is v0.1.0 / build 0.1.0-extracted-core-css and is bootstrap-owned rather than manifest-module-loaded.
Tampermonkey @name remains fixed as WITCH DOCK - DEV while the visible Dock title is WITCH DOCK - DEV v1.3.6.
The launcher fetches core source and the external core stylesheet in parallel through PRIVILEGED_HOST.requestText and applies CSS before core UI construction.

The launcher guards exactly one legacy addStyles seam, compares the extracted stylesheet to the inline legacy CSS contract with only the validated 40px-to-48px compact-icon delta, and fails visibly on mismatch.
Runtime Dev state reports coreStylesMode external-bootstrap-css and coreStylesApplied true; KWWitchDockStylesInfo identifies the v0.1.0 stylesheet and privileged-bootstrap owner.
The correct inline compact emblem remains unchanged and renders at 48x48 inside the existing compact button.
Module loader still completes 23/23 with zero failures and existing cache/order/enablement behavior is unchanged.
Raw GM_* privileges remain unexposed page-side.
No storage, registration, drag/minimize, hotkey, bone-HUD, module-loader, or feature lifecycle ownership moves in the v1.3.6 CSS extraction.
Checked-in Witch_Dock.user.js remains Stable-derived during this bounded migration seam; physical deletion of duplicated legacy CSS belongs to the later core split, not this validation step.
Before integration to WITCH_DEV_MAIN, task-specific URLs are normalized to canonical Dev and revalidated.

notes: New Dev began directly from the Stable baseline above.
Governance/documentation files are intentionally Dev-specific and are not runtime divergences.
Every intentional runtime difference requires an open issue/task and this ledger.
Task-branch self-routing is temporary validation infrastructure, not canonical channel behavior.
